notes: Paper (arXiv 2310.17389) describes a first-stage process where about 61% of prompts were never shown to humans (Perspective below ~0.037). The released toxicchat0124 set has 44.4% with human_annotation=False (4511/10165), matching the HF card (5654 human annotations). We treat HF-card counts as authoritative for this subset and keep population = human_annotation==True.
Paper overall rates (context): tox 7.10%, jb 1.75%. Observed all-rows: tox 7.34%, jb 2.01% (HF card: 7.33%, 2.01%). Human-annotated subset: tox 13.19%, jb 3.61%.
